decisions.problem: Replace keyword-overlap retrieval with evidence-based ranking
decisions.chosen: Weighted multi-signal ranking: semantic 0.40, verification 0.15, KD 0.10, recency 0.10, frequency 0.15, approval 0.10
decisions.evidence: Benchmark RUN-003: precision +8.3%, recall +25.0% over baseline
decisions.risksAccepted: Semantic weighting favors recall over precision on small suites

decisions.problem: Weight optimizer found no better configuration on the 12-scenario suite
decisions.chosen: Stop weight tuning; pivot to benchmark suite expansion
decisions.evidence: OPT-1: 18 candidates, 0 winners; OPT-2: 18 candidates, 0 winners
decisions.risksAccepted: Suite too small to reward further tuning; overfitting risk if tuned on 12 scenarios
decisions.rollbackPlan: Re-enable tuning after suite grows past ~30 scenarios

decisions.problem: Continuous benchmark generation as the suite growth engine
decisions.chosen: Every PR/incident proposes a Draft benchmark; human approval promotes to Canonical
decisions.evidence: Coverage report: performance 0%, security 10%, disaster 14% under-trained
decisions.risksAccepted: Draft queue could grow without review; auto-promotion rejected to preserve governance

decisions.problem: Connect 39 orphan THINK tokens to incidents/decisions/benchmarks
decisions.chosen: Evidence-based domain + agent linking in knowledge-graph
decisions.evidence: Graph edges 34→108, orphans 39→5, both audits pass
